content:
**Power Patcher** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Your power armor breaks more slowly and is cheaper to repair.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your Power Armor breaks 60% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 00391F24 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your Power Armor breaks 40% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 00391F23 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your Power Armor breaks 20% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 00391F22 | 

- Ranks 2 and 3 reduce required materials for repairs by 40% and 60%, respectively.
- The analogous perk for pipe weapons is Licensed Plumber and White Knight for armor. The closest analogous perk for non-pipe weapons is Gunsmith, though the perk has a maximum effect of 50% over five ranks rather than 60% over three ranks, as well as including access to higher-tier gun crafting recipes.

Other perks that increase durability include:

- Gunsmith - ranged weapons
- Licensed Plumber - pipe weapons
- Makeshift Warrior - melee weapons
- Stable Tools - power tools
- White Knight - armor
